deploy-orch-bot: Starting prod deploy for service=ingest-workers environment=prod
change-window=23:00-23:30 UTC
commit=3a7f9d2 (Jae Park) https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest-workers/commit/3a7f9d2
PR=#4512 https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest-workers/pull/4512
rolling: canary -> full if canary healthy
notes: small schema guard + backfill disabled
pinned-runtime: runtime=1.12.0, quant=4bit
If rollback needed run: ```/orch rollback 3a7f9d2```

Jae Park: Ack. migration is a null-safe guard, backfill disabled as discussed. I'll be monitoring the job queue. :+1:

Olivia Chen: Oncall here — watching latency and error-rate. I'll pause rollout if error_rate > 2% for 5m.

Rafa: Quick ask — can deploy messages include both commit author and PR title in the bot summary? makes triage faster.

deploy-orch-bot: Update: included PR title in summary per Rafa's request. PR title: "avoid duplicate inserts on retry" by Jae Park
Canary deployed to host-12, host-14 at 23:03:22 UTC. Health checks passed (3/3).

oncall-sre: Seeing a brief 504 spike from host-14 at 23:05:10 UTC, request latency up ~600ms for ~30s. Investigating.

oncall-sre: spike correlated with a large fanout job, not DB migration. Initiating quick rollback to be safe.

oncall-sre: ```/orch rollback 3a7f9d2 --targets canary```

deploy-orch-bot: Rollback initiated for canary commit 3a7f9d2. Restoring previous sha 2f1c4b0 on host-12 and host-14.

deploy-orch-bot: Rollback complete at 23:06:12 UTC. Canary hosts back to sha 2f1c4b0. Full rollout halted; tagging release as "rolled-back" and opening a follow-up ticket.

Jae Park: Thanks — I'll add a guard to the fanout path and open PR for a lighter retry strategy.

Olivia Chen: Good call. Marking this change-window as partial-fail and will re-schedule after fixes. :calendar:
